name: nudgewhen
description: Nudges in Claude Code: take a break, go to bed, and any reminder you set with /nudge or by asking Claude.

sit_minutes.title: Break nudge after (minutes)
sit_minutes.description: Unbroken time at the keyboard before the status line and agent launches nudge a break. The status line gets louder at twice this.

away_minutes.title: A break is (minutes)
away_minutes.description: Time with no keyboard or mouse input that counts as a break.

bedtime_nudge.title: Bedtime nudge
bedtime_nudge.description: Show a wrap-up nudge in the status line between bedtime and wake-up.

bedtime.title: Bedtime (HH:MM)
bedtime.description: Local time the bedtime nudge starts, as HH:MM in 24-hour time.

wake.title: Wake-up (HH:MM)
wake.description: Local time the bedtime nudge ends, as HH:MM in 24-hour time.

work_hours.title: Work hours (HH:MM-HH:MM)
work_hours.description: Break nudges only run inside these hours. Empty means always.

work_days.title: Work days
work_days.description: Break nudges only run on these days, a comma list of mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun. Empty means every day.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours (HH:MM-HH:MM)
quiet_hours.description: No toasts or notifications in these hours; the status line still shows. A reminder that came due fires when they end. Empty means none.

status_segments.title: Status line segments
status_segments.description: A comma list in display order. Free: sit, break, next, bed, breaks, context, limits, cost, model, branch. Hosted: hosted, ci, reviews. Unknown names are skipped.
